blocks.text: Blood pressure (khoon ka dabao) woh zor (force) hai jo khoon, khoon ki naliyon ki andar ki deewaron par lagata hai. Yahi zor khoon ko dil se le kar jism ki tamam capillaries tak behta rakhta hai. Agarche yeh dabao poore vascular system (naliyon ke nizam) mein hota hai, lekin aam taur par “blood pressure” se murad systemic arteries ka dabao (systemic arterial blood pressure) hota hai. Blood pressure aorta mein sab se zyada hota hai aur phir systemic arteries mein aahista aahista kam hota jata hai. Arteries ki deewarein lachakdar (elastic) hoti hain. Khoon ke bahao se arteries mein ek baqaida dhak-dhak (throbbing) hoti hai jise nabz (pulse) kehte hain.

Arteries mein khoon ka dabao cardiac cycle ke marhalon (phases) ke saath barhta aur ghatta hai. Jab ventricles sukarte hain (ventricular systole) to dil khoon ko zor se pulmonary arteries aur aorta mein dhakelta hai. Is se in arteries mein dabao tezi se barh jata hai. Ventricular systole ke dauran sab se zyada dabao systolic pressure kehlata hai. Ek sehatmand naujawan baligh mein systolic pressure 120 mm Hg hota hai. Jab ventricles dheele hote hain (diastole) to arteries mein dabao gir jata hai. Agle ventricular contraction se pehle arteries mein jo sab se kam dabao baqi rehta hai use diastolic pressure kehte hain. Sehatmand naujawan baligh mein diastolic pressure 75-85 mm Hg hota hai.

Rivaaj ke mutabiq blood pressure ki reading 120/80 likhi jati hai (pehle systolic, phir diastolic). Haath se systolic aur diastolic pressure naapne ke liye sphygmomanometer naam ka aala istemal hota hai. Is aale mein mercury (para) ka column oopar neeche ho kar blood pressure ki reading dikhata hai.

blocks.alt: Graph jis ke y-axis par blood pressure (mm of Hg) aur aorta, arteries, arterioles, capillaries, venules, veins aur vena cava ki rangeen pattiyan hain. Aorta aur arteries mein peeli lakeer systolic (qareeb 120) aur diastolic (qareeb 80) ke beech oopar neeche hoti hai; arterioles mein yeh lehrein khatm hoti hain aur dabao tezi se qareeb 30 tak girta hai, phir capillaries aur venules se hota hua vena cava mein taqreeban sifar ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dabao sab se zyada aorta mein hai aur dil se door hote hue girta jata hai; sab se zyada giraawat arterioles mein hoti hai. Isi liye 120/80 arteries mein napa jata hai.
Blood pressure ka control (Regulation of Blood Pressure)

Dabao mehsoos karne wale receptors, jinhen baroreceptors kehte hain, carotid arteries (jo sar aur dimagh ko khoon deti hain) aur aortic arch (aorta ka woh mura hua hissa jo oopar jane wali aur neeche aane wali aorta ke beech hai) mein hote hain. Jab blood pressure girta hai to baroreceptors sensory neurons (hiss wale nerve cells) ko jagate hain, jo dimagh ko khabar bhejte hain. Dimagh ka control centre jawab mein dil ke sukarne ki raftar aur zor barha deta hai, aur arterioles mein vasoconstriction (naliyon ko tang karna) karwata hai. Yeh dono tabdeeliyan blood pressure ko wapas normal kar deti hain.

Blood pressure ka lambe arse (long-term) ka control hormones karte hain. Kuch hormones gurdon (kidneys) mein pani aur namak ki reabsorption (dobara khoon mein jazb hona) par asar daal kar khoon ki miqdar (volume) control karte hain. Jab khoon ki miqdar aur blood pressure kam ho jaye to dimagh mein maujood khaas receptors pyaas paida karte hain. Yeh posterior pituitary gland ko antidiuretic hormone (ADH) nikalne par bhi uksate hain. ADH gurdon se kehta hai ke zyada pani khoon mein rakho aur peshab (urine) mein kam nikalo. Is se khoon ki miqdar aur aakhir kaar blood pressure wapas theek ho jata hai. ADH arterioles ko tang bhi karta hai, jis se arteries mein blood pressure barhta hai.

Daen atrium ki deewaron mein endocrine cells (hormone banane wale cells) hote hain jo atrial natriuretic hormone (ANH) nikalte hain. Jab khoon ki miqdar barhne se atrium khinchta (stretch hota) hai to daan atrium ANH nikalta hai. ANH peshab ke zariye namak aur pani ka ikhraj (bahar nikalna) tez kar deta hai, jis se khoon ki miqdar aur blood pressure kam ho jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Garam mausam mein ek shakhs bohat sa mayah kho deta hai. Woh do nizam, tez aur sust, bayan karein jo us ka khoon ka dabao qaim rakhte hain.
blocks.explanation: Tez: dabao ka girna carotid arteries aur aortic arch ke baroreceptors mehsoos karte hain, aur dimagh seconds mein dharkan ki raftar aur quwwat barha kar aur arterioles sukar kar jawab deta hai. Sust: dimagh ke receptors kam hajm darj karte hain, pyaas paida karte aur posterior pituitary se ADH nikalwate hain, jo gurdon se pani rakhwata aur kam peshab nikalwata hai aur arterioles bhi sukarta hai, ghanton mein hajm aur dabao bahal karta hai.

items: Blood pressure naliyon ki deewaron par khoon ka zor hai; aorta mein sab se zyada. Arteries ki lachakdar deewar mein dhak-dhak nabz (pulse) hai.
Systolic pressure (ventricles sukarne par) 120 mm Hg; diastolic pressure (ventricles dheele hone par) 75-85 mm Hg; reading 120/80 likhi jati hai aur sphygmomanometer se naapi jati hai.
Jaldi wala control: carotid arteries aur aortic arch ke baroreceptors → dimagh → dil tez aur zor se, arterioles tang.
Lambe arse ka control: khoon kam ho to pyaas aur ADH (gurde pani rokte hain, arterioles tang); khoon zyada ho to daan atrium ANH nikalta hai (namak aur pani peshab mein nikalte hain).
